newsitem.title: CONGO: Malaria kills two million in Africa every year.
newsitem.headline: Malaria kills two million in Africa every year.

text.p: Malaria kills two million people in Africa every year, particularly children, the World Health Organisation said on Wednesday.
WHO Africa director Doctor Ebrahim Malick Samba told a news conference that 300 million of the 400 million cases registered worldwide each year were in Africa.

He said malaria was spreading to new countries on the continent while the mosquito-transmitted parasites causing the disease were showing greater resistance to traditionally-used drugs such a chloroquin, especially in east Africa.
He said mosquito nets impregnated with insecticide were proving an effective way of cutting the number of cases.
About 30 specialists from 20 African countries are taking part in a four-day workshop in Congo's capital Brazzaville on the fight against the disease. The workshop began on Tuesday.
